**TypeAssist 1.6.4**: offline autocorrect and word prediction for **Persian and English** in every Windows app.

### Fixed
- **Words merging or a space disappearing.** Chrome, Edge and Telegram delete a half-space (ZWNJ) together with the letter before it. When TypeAssist fixed a word that contained a half-space, it deleted one character too many, so the space before the word vanished and words merged (`وجود پایه‌گذران` → `وجودپایه‌گذاران`). TypeAssist now never deletes and retypes text that contains a half-space or a diacritic.
- **A half-space turned into a real space.** When Windows reports a different keyboard than the one you're typing with, Shift+Space was read as a plain space, so part of a word could be "fixed" and a real space written in place of the half-space. Shift+Space no longer ends a word.
- **Persian words "corrected" into English.** With a misreported keyboard, Persian letters on punctuation keys (`ج`, `و`, `گ`) looked like punctuation, and the rest of the word was autocorrected into English. TypeAssist now skips a fix whenever another keyboard reads the same keys as a word.

Checked with a new simulation of 14,000 sentences typed in fast bursts, with half-spaces, misreported keyboards and apps that delete half-spaces with the letter before them: no word lost or merged, and no correct word replaced with the other language.

### Upgrading
1. Right-click the tray icon → **Exit**. If you see "TypeAssist is already running" when starting the new one, the old one is still active.
2. Download `TypeAssist-1.6.4.zip` below; before extracting, right-click → Properties → tick **Unblock**.
3. Run `TypeAssist.exe` and check the version under **About TypeAssist…**.

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/mkovich/TypeAssist/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
